card_title: Here I Am, Here I Am
description: God is not the one who is far. He is standing there saying here I am to a whole nation that will not even turn its head. The distance is not on His end.
excerpt: God is not the one who is far. He is not the one hiding. He is not the one refusing to be found. He is standing there saying, here I am, here I am, to a whole nation that will not even turn its head.
verse: "The Lord says, 'I was ready to respond, but no one asked for help. I was ready to be found, but no one was looking for me. I said, "Here I am, here I am!" to a nation that did not call on my name.'"
body_html:
This verse is such an invitation.

God is not the one who is far. He is not the one hiding. He is not the one refusing to be found. He is standing there saying, here I am, here I am, to a whole nation that will not even turn its head.

He is ready to respond. Ready to be found. Ready to be called on. The distance we sometimes feel between us and Him is not on His end. It is on ours.

You see this play out in real lives all the time. Someone who has been running from God for years finally hits a wall. Cries out. And He is right there. He was not late. He was not slow. He was not deciding whether or not to answer. He had been waiting for that moment the whole time.

That is who God is.

He is not a distant God. He is not a reluctant God. He is not the kind of God you have to convince. He is a God who has been actively saying here I am the entire time. It is us who have to stop and turn and finally see Him standing there.

This is the good news we get to share.

That whoever we are talking to, whoever they are, whatever they have done, however far they think they have run, God is not the one holding out. He is ready. He is available. He is right there. All they have to do is call on His name.

I love that this promise is so simple. There is no complicated process. There is no earning it. There is no proving yourself first. Just call. Just look. Just ask. And you will find that He was there the whole time.

Who in your life needs to hear that God is not the one who is far, and that He is ready to respond the moment they turn toward Him?
question: Who in your life needs to hear that God is not the one who is far, and that He is ready to respond the moment they turn toward Him?
